newsitem.title: USA: Southwall names Ray Christie as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Southwall names Ray Christie as CFO.

text.p: Southwall Technologies Inc said Wednesday it had appointed Ray Christie as vice president, finance and chief financial officer.
The company said Christie, who had worked as its controller since April 1996, would assume his new post November 1.
Christie will replace Alfred Larrenaga as chief financial officer, it said, adding that Larrenaga would become senior vice president for corporate development.
Southwall Technologies Inc designs and produces thin film coatings that selectively absorb, reflect or conduct certain types of electromagnetic radiation.
